main_text.p: replerent? Sed pergat. Illud semper, inquit, constitit, vitanda esse duo praecipitia. 2. Partitio.Prius: ne peccandi causas Deo, aut damnatio-nem fatali necessitati adscribamus. Posterius: ne boni salutaris originem, ad vires referamus depravatae naturae. Quis nostrum negat? Videamus tamen probationem I. Manichaeiejus, quod dixit; ambo semper constitisse. De priore inquit: illud Veteres anxie vitas-se, etiam qui de Praedestinatione sublimius sentiebant. Et tame producit, no nisi unius 1. Synodus Arausica. [?]a. secundaConcilij Arausicani secundi canonem ultimum: trium item Doctorum; duorum quidem veterum, Prosperi discipuli, & Augustini praeceptoris; unius autem recentioris, Gersonis, mortui An. 1429. & unius quoque historici, Sigeberti, testimonia.

Quid vero illi contra nos? Et primo Concilium Arausicanum Secundum? Quid sentiendum sit de Conciliis, universe explicat, cum alias, tum pag. 32. 33.34. &c. Quid ergo nos gravat provinciali? Quid tamen illud? Anathema dicit, credentibus, aliquos ad malum praedestinatos

page.notes: Left margin notes read with doubt: the marginal number before "Synodus" and the abbreviation after "Arausica" ("2a." or similar) are not clear. Faint show-through of text from the reverse appears at the top of the page and is left out. The right side is the edge of the adjoining page, also left out. No running head, catchword or signature is legible. Printed "Prius" and "Deo" kept as printed. Tags for the marginal notes "1." and "2." were transcribed as they appear.
